map_corrections: APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md step 9: 00beda60 does not store DAT_0109ceec. The singleton base constructor 00bda6f0, reached through 00be1dc0, assigns it under the lifetime lock and registers the manager; 00bda790 zeroes it on teardown.
APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md step 12: at 0073d829 "filestore" is the system path and "." is the virtual path, the reverse of the first two mounts.
APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md step 9 names only manager+0x90. manager+0x8c receives 00735b30, which like 00530620 is a single C3 byte followed by INT3 padding. 00735b30 has no Ghidra function.
prior_work_corrections: PROVIDER_FACTORY_STARTUP.md and ARCHIVE_PROVIDER_ENTRY.md describe three startup factories. A fourth, MPAK 00736b60, is registered at 0073d95d.
PROVIDER_FACTORY_STARTUP.md's startup mount table omits the FileStore mount's ownership byte, which is 0 and not the 1 the two physical mounts push.
APP_INIT_PLATFORM.md leaves the identity of the DAT_010904e0 registry open. It guards DAT_010904dc, the cached mpak provider that the MPAK factory create method 00bb83a0 returns.

RESOURCE_MANAGER_REGISTRATION.md gives the two application parsers' primary vtables but not their lifetime vtables: AnimationChannels base 00cfea08 / final 00cfea34, Bone base 00cfea0c / final 00cfea44.
sequencing_consequences: The command line is parsed at 0073d94a, after every mount and both package scans, so -cachedload cannot influence phase 2. Its only effect in this packet is the byte stored at manager+0x78.
The MPAK factory is registered after both 0073cb10 package scans, and 0073cb10 enumerates extension mpkg only, so startup package scanning never mounts a .mpak archive.
The PAK lock 00bb40b0 is created at 0073d988, after the MPAK factory it protects has already been registered at 0073d95d.
Descending signed mount priority means filestore (300) precedes persistent_data (99) precedes the loose root (0) for every later asset load.
The two parsers registered at 0073db50 and 0073db64 extend the six the manager constructor registers; the five game parsers of 00717e80 are registered later from 004ddb90, outside Init.
open_questions: The decimal 100 at PAK-registry +0x0c and the list at +0x10/+0x14/+0x18 are not interpreted; the PakArchiveRegistry name is provisional and rests on the mpak provider being the only observed consumer.
00bb5770 and 00bb5910 are read only far enough to see VFS name resolution and the +0x14 count.
0073d642 and 0073d652 re-read DAT_0109ceec with no null check, so a failed malloc(0x0a0) would store through a null manager. Whether the allocator can return null there is not established.
00be0660 performs no duplicate check, so a second Init pass would append the MPAK factory again. Whether Init is ever re-entered is not established.
GetCurrentDirectoryA is given a length of 0x0fa but _strcat_s a size of 0x100; the declared buffer size is not recovered.
00bb82f0, the writer of DAT_010904dc, is not analyzed.
